issues.finding: Coverage source concentration uses canonical-action count although repeated axis/gamma variants of the same event have separate canonical actions, while C1 samples uniformly by event signature. Repeating non-dominant-source event variants can turn the <=20% action-share gate from fail to pass without adding any event signatures or responsible sessions, and without reducing the dominant-source probability under C1.
issues.counterexample: A pool with60 unique event signatures/actions,20 from sessionA and40 from other sessions initially fails20/60. Adding40 axis/gamma variants only of those other existing signatures makes20/100 pass, while A still represents20/60 signatures (and can dominate one D/X selected membership). Other predeclared count/type floors can stay unchanged.
issues.concrete_fix: Define source-concentration admission on deduplicated dangerous event signatures, or preferably the actual declared C1 D/X slot/signature/member sampling probabilities (with explicit membership scope); preserve raw action-share as descriptive only. Require that adding repetitions of existing event signatures without new responsible sources cannot rescue coverage admission. Mirror denominator/threshold in basis and add a structural fixture for this invariance.
